description:
Get a chatbot

Returns the full public configuration of one chatbot, including the system prompt, the widget appearance, the widget voice, the embedding restrictions and the retention settings. `allowedDomains` and `supportedLanguages` come back as arrays, or as null when nothing is configured. Internal voice engine identifiers are never included. A reseller key may read any chatbot belonging to that reseller; an ordinary key only its own.
name: get_chatbot
title: Get a chatbot
